stemMarkdown: Two cars start at the same time from two points 357 km apart and travel towards each other at 42 km/h and 44 km/h respectively. After how many hours will they meet? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Relative speed (approaching) $= 42 + 44 = 86$ km/h. Time to meet $= \dfrac{\text{distance}}{\text{relative speed}} = \dfrac{357}{86} = 4.15$ hours.
